name: DocHub
description:
DocHub lets you create, edit, upload, and manage documents directly from your Claude conversation. Use natural language to create ready-to-use PDFs, make quick edits, upload files to your DocHub account, and find the documents you need. 
Prepare signature request drafts, track sign-in progress, and see who still needs to sign - all in one conversation.
You can use DocHub to:

Create documents:
“Create a simple NDA for a freelance design project.”

Fill form fields:
"What form fields does my intake form have? Fill in the client details below."

Prepare and send sign requests:
"Create a sign request from my standard NDA template and send it for signature to john@example.com."

Track signing progress:
“Show me which signature requests are still waiting to be signed.”

_published_faq.name: How do I add DocHub to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DocHub to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://dochub.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DocHub MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DocHub lists 15 MCP tools, including dochub_assign_formfield, dochub_create_sign_request_draft_from_template, dochub_create_sign_request_from_document, dochub_fill_formfield, dochub_generate_document, dochub_get_current_user, dochub_get_document, dochub_get_sign_request, dochub_list_documents, dochub_list_formfields, dochub_list_sign_requests, and dochub_modify_document.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DocHub?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DocHub in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
DocHub requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DocHub is developed by DocHub. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
